value.name: graph-partition
value.premises: Partition accepts only immutable public BoundaryInputs supplied by records; its Debug includes complete public acts and closures. The return retains structural identities, one least shared identity per intersection edge and complete block vectors. No input or output contains a secret carrier, no graph result feeds observation back into computation, and no serializer or canonical publication path is exposed. Invocation totals and inclusive durations are observed; algorithmic work and allocation bounds are not claimed.
